bio.text: Houston Gaines is the Republican nominee for Georgia's 10th Congressional District in the November 2026 general election.
He has represented District 120 in the Georgia House of Representatives, and according to his campaign website has served in the State House since 2019.
According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Athens, where he lives, and was student body president at the University of Georgia.
Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from the University of Georgia and a career as a consultant.
